name: upright_bass
description: Jewelbox 21 Acoustic Bass (jazz upright, plucked): four thick gut strings (the striker) over a large dark-amber violin-family body face-on - sloping upper bouts, C-bouts, f-holes, ebony fingerboard, tall maple bridge, black tailpiece and chrome end-pin - with a long neck ending in a carved scroll and four brass tuning machines. No bow (the orchestral contrabass, 28, gets one).
